title: Cozy Survival Starter House
subtitle: Tier 1 Starter Cottage with 4 Living Alcoves & 2-Wide L-Shaped Corner Stairs
author: MineVault Studio

screenshots.caption: Exterior Gable Front with Porch, Timber Framing & Deepslate Tile Trim
Ground Floor Living Room with Chandelier, Hearth Fireplace & 2-Wide L-Stairs

description: An authentic, in-game verified Tier 1 survival starter cottage. Built with 100% collision-safe clearances: flush threshold entry across the porch, double-door clearance, and an authentic community-style 2-wide L-shaped corner staircase with a 2x2 flat landing and reverse-stair undersides climbing toward the high center roof ridge for continuous 5-6 blocks of headroom. Fully equipped with 4 dedicated functional zones: Hearth & Cooking Alcove, Central Living Room, Workshop & Smithing Alcove, and a cozy Loft Bedroom with Study Desk.
features: In-game verified zero-collision player headroom along all walking paths and doorways
Flush foundation: Seamless entry across exterior porch, door threshold, and interior floor
2-Wide L-shaped corner staircase with 2x2 turning landing, reverse-stair finished underside, and under-stair storage
4 Functional Interior Zones: Cooking hearth, living room with chandelier, crafting workshop, and loft bedroom
Full Survival Utility: Working double chest, campfire fireplace, water cauldron sink, smoker, bed, and bookshelf storage
Authentic community aesthetic: 3-layer stone foundation gradient, stripped dark oak timber framing, and contrasting deepslate tile roof trim

title: Medieval Village Blacksmith & Armoury
subtitle: Tier 1 Working Blacksmith with Open-Air Lava Forge, Twin Blast Furnaces & Upper Loft Residence
author: MineVault Studio

screenshots.caption: Exterior 3/4 Perspective with Open-Air Lava Forge, Chimney Smoke & Cobblestone Apron
Front Façade showing Timber Framing, Spruce Door, Windows & Deepslate Hearth
Interior Armoury & Hall with Red Carpet, Smithing Station, Chests & Hanging Lanterns

description: A master-tier medieval village blacksmith and weapons armoury rebuilt following authentic reference blueprints. Features true 3D architectural depth with recessed plaster wall panels framed by exposed stripped dark oak timber posts and a 1-block cantilevered jetty upper floor. An open-air stone and deepslate forge pavilion boasts a safety iron-gated molten lava crucible, active dual blast furnaces, an anvil mounted on an oak plinth, a steel-quenching water trough, and a towering stone chimney with signal fire smoke. An authentic 3-wide open timber and stone archway connects directly into the enclosed showroom armoury with weapon racks, armor stands, and double storage chests with zero-obstruction lid clearances. A center-ridge ascending wooden staircase with continuous 3.0-block vertical headroom and finished reverse undersides leads into a cozy upper residential loft under a sweeping fantasy curved Gothic roof with outset bargeboards, decorative spire finials, and cascading azalea foliage.
features: Master 3D Layering: 1-block recessed wall panels framed between proud stripped timber columns with authentic beam peg detailing
Cantilevered Medieval Jetty: Second floor extends 1 block out past the stone foundation with inverted stair corbels and timber brackets
Dynamic Gothic Fantasy Roof: Variable-pitch curving deepslate tile roof with flared eaves, outset gable bargeboards, and ornamental timber spires
Open-Air Working Forge: Safety iron-gated lava crucible, twin blast furnaces, working anvil, grindstone, water trough, and towering chimney smoke plume
Grand 3-Wide Open Archway: Seamless, obstruction-free walking passage connecting the active outdoor forge to the indoor armoury showroom
Center-Ridge Ascending Staircase: Climbs toward the highest roof pitch with guaranteed 3.0-block headroom above every step and clean reverse stair undersides
Organic Foliage & Weathering: Cascading flowering azalea and oak leaves, window flower boxes with potted blossoms, and a natural stone foundation skirt
